input_law: all 1,722 ordered distinct nonidentity point pairs on E(F_47): y^2=x^3-x-2, order 43, centered coordinate lift
coefficient_family: for distinct centered x coordinates, a1,a2,a3=47*(k1,k2,k3) with each k in {-1,0,1}; solve a4,a6 exactly from both point equations
same_x: record each such pair as unconstructed for this uniquely solved family, with zero candidate choices

gates.7: integral coefficients, good reduction, incidence rank 2, order 4
gates.11_strict: integral coefficients, good reduction, incidence rank 2, order 6
gates.11_weak: integral coefficients, good reduction, incidence rank 2, order 7

selection: first candidate per pair satisfying gate 7 and the arm's gate 11
relation: source reduced P1+2P2 flag; check rational P1+2P2 for selected candidates and local 7 and 11 relation on every selected candidate
record: per-pair candidate status counts, selected candidate and relation flags, global candidate-stream SHA-256; retain all 1,722 rows
resource: complete 45,360-candidate exact arithmetic census; no timing comparison
interpretation: bounded coefficient family under the full input law, not the unrestricted CRT search
